#Sentinel, Tier 1
##Playing as a Sentinel You are relatively fragile, but fast and ranged. Use your spits to disrupt hosts on the frontline and transport hosts.
Corner peak around corners or behind other xenos, and stack paratoxin stacks on hosts, this lets you spit while minimizing risk to yourself, if any host gets too close then you can use your catalytic tail stab to gain speed and armor to escape.
You can also capture hosts that are alone by paratoxin spitting them to max stacks and biting them with draining bite, then tackle them.
##Paratoxin Stacks:
Your paratoxin spit and paratoxin slashes give hosts paratoxin stacks, which on their own do oxygen damage over time, and isn't very dangerous by itself. You mainly should focus on using them to combo with your draining bite and/or catalytic tail stab.
The most damage possible from paratoxin is 40 at max stacks, so you won't kill a host just spitting them! Stacks will naturally dissipate after some time if you stop applying them.
Paratoxin Stacks only go up to 30!
##Abilities: - [bold]Paratoxin Spit[/bold]: Glob a spit that slows hosts, drains their chemicals, and applies 5 paratoxin stacks. If they have no armor it will stun them down. This isn't blocked by allied xenos!
- [bold]Paratoxin Slashes[/bold]: Empowers your next 3 attacks or tailstabs to inject 10 paratoxin stacks.
- [bold]Catalytic Tail Stab[/bold]: Does extra burn damage for each paratoxin stack on a host. Gives you 25 armor and double speed for 3.5 seconds if they have at least 10 stacks, great for hosts pushing you. Drains 1/2 of the paratoxin stacks from the host.
- [bold]Draining Bite[/bold]: Stuns a host for a very short time with no paratoxin stacks. With paratoxin stacks the stun time is much higher and it also drains medical chems. Drains 1/3 of the paratoxin stacks from the host. Great for capturing at max stacks.
